notes.title: 《KunKun dream Startles the Soul》 Update Content Preview
notes.notes:
Because we are developing another single-player game, the multiplayer game will be updated slowly, but we will ensure the update progress.

Updated three new bosses
[list]
    [*]Blue Demon Chicken---Heroes can be wronged, but you can't step on my Chelsea
    [*]Brother Yifan---my beloved brother, has gone to operate the sewing machine. Let's use various methods to make him operate faster.
    [*]Brother Tiger---Don't let me see you on Shenyang Street, or I'll pull your hood off if I see you
[/list]
